test a different weighting method (softmax_neg_error) to see if a sharper weight distribution improves over inverse_error under unstable ranking.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking, so a robust DBA (dynamic Bayesian averaging) may outperform simple weighted combos.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of extreme errors.
Try a weighted combination using forward‑selection weights on the smaller, more stable pool4 to see if a sparse, robust set beats the full‑pool weighted combos.
test forward‑selection weights on full pool
test robust median on stable 7‑model pool
test robust mean on the stable 7‑model pool
try softmax weighting on the stable pool
test weighted mean on stable pool with inverse error

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9692. Series context: trend strength 0.9728 and seasonal strength 0.5707; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.08); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.461.
